senses.gloss: m., pl. קְפִיצִין (cmp. קָפַץ; קֶבֶץ, a. Syr. קופסא poples, P. Sm. 3696) joints, hams of the knee.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 1:7">Ez. I, 7</cite>) <he>אין להם ק׳</he> they have no joints (cannot bend their knees).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:3">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Pesik. R. s. 22</cite> <he>מלאכי … ק׳</he> the angels of destruction have no joints (cannot sit or lie down); a. e.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 11:1">Tosef. Par. XI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 10:1">X</cite>), 1 <he>ספק הקְפָצִין</he> a doubtful levitical uncleanness based on contact with one’s legs, opp. to <he>הידים</he>.
